\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta,calc}
\begin{tikzpicture}[x=1cm,y=1cm,font=\normalsize,line width=.6pt]
% two horizontal boundary lines
\draw[solid] (0,1) -- (8,1);
\draw[solid] (0,-1) -- (8,-1);
% middle smooth wave generated by sine formula: y = 0.28*sin(deg(2*pi*x/2.4))
\draw[solid,domain=0:8,samples=200] plot (\x,{0.28*sin(360*\x/2.4)});
\end{tikzpicture}
